subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does any supported ACP client or upstream adapter perform asynchronous tokenization or partial payload dispatch that can reach OpenClaw before the current approval decision resolves?
rationale: The current OpenClaw files do not contain the reported mechanism, but the protected security allegation could involve an upstream protocol implementation and should not be dismissed without an ACP owner confirming that boundary.

options.title: Privately verify the boundary
options.body: Request the exact adapter/version, payload, protocol trace, and current-main reproduction through a private GitHub Security Advisory before choosing a code change.

options.title: Close after owner confirmation
options.body: Close as unsubstantiated if an ACP owner confirms that supported clients cannot dispatch payload fragments before permission resolution and no current reproduction is supplied.

recommendation.title: Privately verify the boundary
recommendation.body: Request the exact adapter/version, payload, protocol trace, and current-main reproduction through a private GitHub Security Advisory before choosing a code change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects vincentkoc to the semantic ACP approval-classification boundary described by the report.
